text:
sophia: starting staggered-smart-ramp for ff:llm-smart-priority at 23:45 UTC. objective: reduce tail latency without changing top-k behaviour. plan: tiny canary -> progressive cohorts with built-in rollback windows. runtime pinned to v2.4.0 for rollout.
devin: ack. what are the cohort sizes and cadence?
sophia: cohorts: tiny-canary(0.5%), eng-scan(2%), beta(10%), public-1(25%), public-2(60%). cadence: step every 7m, soak 3m; total window ends 01:15 UTC.
cheng: guardrails: immediate rollback if p99 increase > 80ms or error-rate > 0.6% across cohort. pause if HL_METRIC (hallucination proxy) > 1.25x baseline for two consecutive soaks. also abort on any OOMs.
sophia: deploy-bot, please pin and announce each step. keep rollout tag in release notes.
deploy-bot: scheduled: ff:llm-smart-priority -> tiny-canary(0.5%), eng-scan(2%), beta(10%), public-1(25%), public-2(60%). start=1717800001 step=7m soak=3m pinned_version=v2.4.0. runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/rls-521
devin: release-note blurb for support: "llm-smart-priority: optimized request prioritizer and attention scheduling; staged rollout pinned to runtime v2.4.0. Watch p99 latency and HL_METRIC."
support: added rollout tag rollout/llm-smart-priority and notified #support-watch.
cheng: quick yank commands if needed:
```
/feature toggle ff:llm-smart-priority off --force
/feature set-cohort ff:llm-smart-priority public-2 0
/feature drain-cohort ff:llm-smart-priority beta --annotate "drain-after-issue"
```
devin: observability: create monitor/p99-llm-priority threshold 80ms eval 5m, monitor/ooms, monitor/hl-metric change (1.25x). alert to #eng-oncall + this channel.
alerts-bot: monitors created -> monitor/p99-llm-priority(80ms), monitor/oom-events, monitor/hl-metric(1.25x). notify channels: #eng-oncall, #eng-releases.
sophia: decision flow: first fire -> pause ramp, collect traces + QA run for 15m. second fire or OOM -> rollback to baseline and open rollback ticket with tags: rollback/llm-smart-priority. keep runtime pinned until ML + eng have signoff.
devin: if we pause, do we unpin? prefer to keep pinned to avoid mixing kernels.
sophia: agree, keep pinned. only unpin after verified patch or rollback.
cheng: starting auxiliary sampling and diff-run on prod-samples. will post 3m aggregates here. tagging anomalies with #smartprio-anom.
sophia: ok starting tiny-canary in 3m. @deploy-bot please post cohort events to thread.
deploy-bot: tiny-canary enabled (0.5%) at 1717800125. rolllog: cohort->tiny-canary, pinned=v2.4.0.
cheng: sampling 200 outputs -> HL_METRIC baseline=0.6% current=0.62% (within noise), p99 delta +6ms. no OOMs.
devin: tail looks stable; dashboards clear.
alerts-bot: heartbeat: no active alerts.
sophia: moving to eng-scan in 7m if no guardrails. reminder: keep short notes; support will copy release blurb for triage.
sophia: also note: if we detect cohort-specific regression (only beta or public-1) we might throttle that cohort back to 0 and continue others. fallback policy: if capacity constrained, route traffic to v2.3.x variant automatically.
devin: commands for cohort throttle:
```
/feature set-cohort ff:llm-smart-priority beta 0
/feature set-cohort ff:llm-smart-priority public-1 10
```
cheng: will start sending sampled traces to runbook ticket and #model-audit.
sophia: final reminder: change window ends at 01:15 UTC. if we leave rollout early, open rollback ticket and ping CSMs for customers with active incidents.
sophia: thanks everyone, will post at each cohort step. :eyes:
